He had a duty to supervise and report. He was negligent, failing to fulfill duty, causing loss. This likely constitutes "徇私舞弊不移交刑事案件" (abuse of power to not transfer criminal case). The list includes "徇私舞弊不移交刑事案件". Also possibly "滥用职权" (abuse of power) but the description: He didn't report, which is a form of dereliction of duty. In Chinese criminal law, there is a crime of "徇私舞弊不移交刑事案件" (private collusion, not handing over criminal case). The facts: He discovered the embezzlement but didn't report, just privately reminded. That is exactly the crime of "徇私舞弊不移交刑事案件". Also maybe "滥用职权" but the list includes both.
